about: Files under lib/ that still call DateTimeInterface::diff() themselves instead of asking Service/Term/DayCount. An entry names the open change that takes the file and says why it is not taken yet. DayCountIsTheOnlyDiffTest fails on a file that is not listed, on an entry without a change or a reason, and on an entry whose file no longer calls diff(), so the list can only shrink.

entries.reason: calculateDaysImpact() counts the days an extension adds. The class sits at the coupling limit (12 of 13), so one more collaborator fails PHPMD. It is a calculation class that owns its day math, which task 4.2 leaves in place; it moves to DayCount when method-decomposition splits the class.

spanFor() counts the calendar span a timer is armed with, and asks WorkingDayRoll for working days. The class sits at the coupling limit (12 of 13), so one more collaborator fails PHPMD. It is a calculation class that owns its day math, which task 4.2 leaves in place; it moves to DayCount when method-decomposition splits the class.

signedDaysUntil() serves only checkAndWarn(), which has had no caller since task 2.1 retired the daily check job. The refactor programme (decision 184) deletes the method; routing it first would only collide with that deletion.
